# Story 01 — Design tokens and the component library (Story: 493)

## Prerequisites

- Story 1.1 completed: the Next.js frontend application exists and runs. Verified: `frontend/` contains a Next.js 16.3.3 app with `app/layout.tsx`, `app/globals.css`, `app/page.tsx`, `lib/api/`, `__tests__/`, `eslint.config.mjs`, `vitest.config.mts`, `tsconfig.json`, and `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.
- Coordinate with the owner of `frontend/app/layout.tsx` — this story will replace its `<html>` element with the bilingual `dir`/`lang` shell, and will replace `frontend/app/globals.css` with the token layer.
- Tailwind CSS **4.3.x** and shadcn/ui (current CLI) are **not yet installed** in `frontend/package.json` (verified via grep — no `tailwind` or `shadcn` matches). This story adds them.
- IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic (SIL OFL 1.1) must be obtained and self-hosted. **Do not** load them from any external CDN in the request path.
- Read `DESIGN.md` (the token authority) before starting. If it is not present at the repo root, request it from the design owner — every token value in this story comes from that file, verbatim.
- Read the attached mockup `.squad/stories/inti/493/attachments/screen-reports.html` (board **R-6** — empty-vs-forbidden). Boards **R-5** (RowActions) and **A-11** (DataTable) live in mockups attached to work items #495 and #498 respectively; obtain and read them before implementing those two components.

## Story Goal

Establish the frontend design-system floor that every subsequent epic will build on:

1. A **token layer** in CSS (colour, spacing, radius, elevation, type) sourced verbatim from `DESIGN.md`, exposed as Tailwind 4 theme variables and as semantic aliases (`--surface-raised`, `--fg-muted`, …). No component may ever reference a primitive (`bg-n-800`) — only semantic tokens (`bg-surface-raised`).
2. A **bilingual RTL shell** that sets `<html dir lang>` per active locale, self-hosts IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic, and applies `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` to every numeric surface.
3. A **four-layer component tree** — (A) restyled shadcn primitives, (B) shared domain components, (C) screen compositions, (D) layout shell — separated in the file tree and enforced by lint.
4. The **Layer-A primitive set** restyled once to the tokens: button (primary/secondary/ghost/destructive), input, select, dropdown, dialog, sheet, toast, tabs, checkbox, radio, tooltip.
5. The **Layer-B domain set** required by this story: `DataTable` (full contract), `RowActions` (persistent overflow control), `EmptyState`, `ForbiddenState`.
6. **Lint rules** that (a) forbid physical Tailwind utilities (`ml-`, `mr-`, `pl-`, `pr-`, `left-`, `right-`, `text-left`, `text-right`) and (b) forbid colour/primitive literals in `components/`, and (c) forbid Layer-A primitives from appearing directly in screen compositions.

**Not in scope for this story** (called out in the intake): the bulk-action bar and multi-select column, the command palette primitive, the AI panel and AI draft treatments, the chart system, the branding controls. Leave these to their own stories; do not stub them.

## Product rules (from story)

**Current behaviour**
- No Tailwind, no shadcn, no design tokens. `frontend/app/globals.css` carries ad-hoc CSS. `frontend/app/layout.tsx` renders `<html lang="en">` with no `dir` and no self-hosted font.
- Component tree layering does not exist; `components/` is absent.
- No lint rule exists to keep physical direction utilities or colour literals out of the codebase.

**New behaviour**
- Tailwind 4.3.x with a `@theme` token block is the only source of design values.
- `<html>` renders with `dir` and `lang` bound to the active locale; `dir="rtl"` for Arabic, `dir="ltr"` for English.
- Only logical Tailwind utilities are allowed: `ms-`, `me-`, `ps-`, `pe-`, `start-`, `end-`, `text-start`, `text-end`. Physical forms are **lint errors**, not review discipline.
- Every numeric surface carries `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` via a `.num` utility class or the `tabular-nums` Tailwind utility.
- Every state that carries meaning survives greyscale — hue is always paired with a glyph, word, weight or shape (UX-03, NFR-13).
- `RowActions` renders its overflow control **persistently**, never revealed on hover (UX-02).
- `ForbiddenState` prints **no numeral** and is visually unmistakable from `EmptyState` (UX-06).

### 2 — The token layer

**Create file:** `frontend/tokens/tokens.css`

Declare **every** value from `DESIGN.md` as CSS custom properties in a `@theme` block. Structure:

```css
@theme {
  /* --- Primitives (never referenced by components) --- */
  --color-n-0: #ffffff;
  --color-n-50: /* from DESIGN.md */;
  /* … the full neutral, brand, accent, semantic scales … */

  --spacing-1: 0.25rem;
  --spacing-2: 0.5rem;
  /* … */

  --radius-sm: 0.25rem;
  --radius-md: 0.5rem;
  --radius-lg: 0.75rem;

  --shadow-e1: /* … */;
  --shadow-e2: /* … */;

  --font-sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;

  --text-xs: /* … */;
  /* … */
}

@layer theme {
  :root {
    /* --- Semantic aliases (the ONLY tokens components may reference) --- */
    --surface-base: var(--color-n-0);
    --surface-raised: var(--color-n-50);
    --surface-sunken: var(--color-n-100);
    --fg-default: var(--color-n-900);
    --fg-muted: var(--color-n-600);
    --fg-inverse: var(--color-n-0);
    --border-default: var(--color-n-200);
    --border-strong: var(--color-n-400);
    --focus-ring: /* from DESIGN.md */;
    --state-success: /* … */;
    --state-warning: /* … */;
    --state-danger: /* … */;
    --state-info: /* … */;
    /* etc. — mirror DESIGN.md exactly */
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] {
    /* dark-mode overrides for every semantic token above */
  }
}
```

**Create file:** `frontend/tokens/tokens.ts`

Re-export the semantic token names as a typed constant so TypeScript code that must compute a class name at runtime has a single source of truth. **Do not** hard-code colour hex or spacing values in this file — every entry references the CSS variable name only.

**File:** `frontend/app/globals.css`

Replace contents with:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "../tokens/tokens.css";

@layer base {
  html, body { background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--fg-default); }
  .num, [data-numeric="true"], td[data-column-type="number"] {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
  }
}
```

**File:** `frontend/app/layout.tsx`

Replace the current `<html>` with a bilingual shell. Pattern:

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { plexSans, plexSansArabic } from "./fonts";
import "./globals.css";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Ragab CRM" };

export default async function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  // Locale resolution: read from cookie / header set by Story 1.1's i18n bootstrap.
  // For this story, expose the plumbing; default to "en" until 1.4 wires the selector.
  const locale = "en"; // TODO(Story 1.4): resolve from request
  const dir = locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr";
  return (
    <html lang={locale} dir={dir} className={`${plexSans.variable} ${plexSansArabic.variable}`}>
      <body className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--surface-base)] text-[var(--fg-default)] font-sans antialiased">
```

Confirm `next.config.ts` does **not** register any `next/font/google` loader — the intake forbids external font CDNs in the request path.

### 4 — Component tree with four layers

Create the folder skeleton:

```
frontend/components/
  ui/          # Layer A — restyled shadcn primitives

  screens/     # Layer C — screen compositions
```

Add a `README.md` in each folder stating the layer contract and citing this story.

### 5 — Restyle Layer-A primitives

Run `pnpm dlx shadcn add button input select dropdown-menu dialog sheet toast tabs checkbox radio-group tooltip` — files land under `frontend/components/ui/`.

For each generated file:
- Remove any hard-coded colour, spacing, radius or shadow. Replace with `var(--…)` references or Tailwind semantic classes bound to the theme.
- Convert every physical utility to its logical form.
- Confirm the primitive imports **only** from `@radix-ui/*`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `class-variance-authority`, and `lucide-react` — no cross-imports from `components/domain/**` or `components/screens/**`.
- **Button** variants: `primary`, `secondary`, `ghost`, `destructive`. Each pairs its colour with a weight/shape/icon slot so meaning survives greyscale.

### 6 — Layer-B domain components

**Create file:** `frontend/components/domain/DataTable/DataTable.tsx`

Contract (verbatim from acceptance criteria, board A-11):

- Server-driven sorting: accepts `sort: { column, direction }` and emits `onSortChange`.
- Filter chips + filter panel: accepts `filters: FilterDef[]`, `activeFilters`, `onFiltersChange`.
- Text search: accepts `search`, `onSearchChange`.
- Column visibility: accepts `columns: ColumnDef[]`; the **identity column is locked visible, not absent** — its visibility toggle is rendered but disabled with an accessible explanation.
- Responsive collapse: below the breakpoint from `DESIGN.md`, secondary columns collapse into a per-row expander.
- RTL: uses only logical utilities; verified with a Vitest test that renders the table under `dir="rtl"` and asserts no physical-direction inline style leaks.
- Real `<table>` semantics: renders `<table><thead><tbody>`; sortable `<th>` uses `aria-sort="ascending|descending|none"`.
- Keyboard navigation: roving tabindex across rows (`↑/↓`) and columns (`←/→`); focus retention across pagination (the row index that had focus receives focus on the new page after re-render).

Split into files:
- `DataTable.tsx` — the component
- `DataTable.types.ts` — `ColumnDef`, `FilterDef`, `SortState`, `DataTableProps`
- `DataTable.aria.ts` — the sort-announcement helper
- `useRovingFocus.ts` — the roving-tabindex hook
- `useRetainFocusAcrossPages.ts` — the focus-retention hook

**Create file:** `frontend/components/domain/RowActions/RowActions.tsx`

Board **R-5** is the normative rendering. The overflow trigger (three-dot menu button) **must be rendered persistently** on every row, not gated by `:hover` or `:focus-within`. Enforce with a Vitest test that renders the row without any hover event and asserts the overflow trigger is in the DOM and visible (`getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== "hidden"`).

**Create file:** `frontend/components/domain/EmptyState/EmptyState.tsx`

Renders an icon slot, headline, description, and optional action slot. Uses `--fg-muted` and a neutral illustration. **May** carry a numeric count when appropriate.

**Create file:** `frontend/components/domain/ForbiddenState/ForbiddenState.tsx`

Board **R-6** is the normative rendering. Must be visually unmistakable from `EmptyState` (different icon, different accent, different heading tone). **Must render no numeral** — the component API refuses a `count` prop; a Vitest test greps the rendered output and fails if any character in `[0-9٠-٩]` is present. This is the UX-06 leak guard.

### 7 — Lint rules

**File:** `frontend/eslint.config.mjs`

Add three rules:

1. **Physical-utility ban.** Use `eslint-plugin-tailwindcss` (or a bespoke `no-restricted-syntax` rule) to fail on any class name matching `^(ml|mr|pl|pr|left|right)-` or exactly `text-left`/`text-right`. Message: `"Use logical utilities (ms-/me-/ps-/pe-/start-/end-/text-start/text-end) — physical utilities break RTL."`
2. **Colour-literal / primitive ban in `components/`.** `no-restricted-syntax` rule that fails on `bg-n-\d+|text-n-\d+|border-n-\d+` (any primitive palette name) and on inline hex literals (`#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}`) inside JSX `className` or `style` attributes under `frontend/components/**`. Message: `"Components must reference semantic tokens (bg-surface-raised, text-fg-muted) — never primitives or literals."`
3. **Layer separation.** `no-restricted-imports` rule that fails when a file under `frontend/components/screens/**` imports directly from `@/components/ui/*` — screens must compose Layer B (`components/domain/**`) and only reach Layer A through it. Message: `"Screens must compose domain components; a screen assembled from repeated Layer-A primitives fails review."`

**Create file:** `frontend/scripts/check-tokens.mjs`

Small Node script that walks `frontend/components/` and greps for the same primitive/hex patterns as rule 2 (belt-and-braces for cases where the ESLint rule is disabled with a directive). Wire it into `package.json` as `"lint:tokens": "node scripts/check-tokens.mjs"` and add it to a `"lint:all"` script.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Arabic-Indic digits inside `ForbiddenState`.** The UX-06 guard must reject `٠-٩` as well as `0-9`. Enforced in `frontend/__tests__/components/ForbiddenState.test.tsx` via the regex `/[0-9\u0660-\u0669]/`.
- **Mixed-direction runs.** A ticket identifier `TKT-000123` embedded in Arabic prose must render in a single face; because `--font-sans` puts Plex Sans Arabic in the stack alongside Plex Sans, the shaper picks one matched face for both scripts. Verified visually against `screen-reports.html` board R-6.
- **RTL retrofit.** Any physical utility introduced later will break Arabic layout silently. The ESLint physical-utility rule is the guard; `pnpm lint` must fail in CI, not warn.
- **Colour-only meaning under greyscale.** Every stateful primitive (button destructive, toast success/warn/danger, tab active) must pair its hue with a glyph or weight change. Enforced by a Vitest snapshot test that renders each state twice — once normally and once under a `filter: grayscale(1)` wrapper — and asserts the accessible name and role remain distinguishable.
- **Font FOUT.** `display: "swap"` on the `next/font/local` loader is deliberate; the fallback (`system-ui`) must not shift layout catastrophically. If baseline shift is visible, tune `adjustFontFallback` on the loader.
- **Column visibility with locked identity column.** The toggle for the identity column renders but is disabled with `aria-disabled="true"` and a tooltip explaining why — the acceptance criterion says "locked, not absent."
- **Focus retention across pagination.** If the underlying rows shrink between pages (last-page short), the retention hook clamps to the last available row rather than losing focus to `<body>`.
- **`dir` flip without reload.** When Story 1.4 later flips the locale at runtime, every logical utility recomputes automatically; verify by adding a Vitest test that mounts `<DataTable>` under a wrapper that toggles `dir` between `"ltr"` and `"rtl"` and asserts no DOM mutation beyond the `dir` attribute.
- **Missing `DESIGN.md`.** If the token authority file is absent when this story starts, **stop and request it** — do not invent token values. Note the blocker in the story's status.

4. **Unit — DataTable keyboard nav (`frontend/__tests__/components/domain/DataTable.keyboard.test.tsx`)** — presses `ArrowDown`, `ArrowUp`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`; asserts focus moves along rows and columns via roving tabindex.
5. **Unit — DataTable focus retention (`frontend/__tests__/components/domain/DataTable.focus.test.tsx`)** — focuses row index 3, triggers page change, asserts row index 3 of the new page receives focus; then triggers a short-last-page and asserts focus clamps to the last row.
6. **Unit — DataTable column visibility (`frontend/__tests__/components/domain/DataTable.columns.test.tsx`)** — asserts the identity column toggle is rendered and `aria-disabled="true"`.
7. **Unit — DataTable RTL (`frontend/__tests__/components/domain/DataTable.rtl.test.tsx`)** — renders the table inside a wrapper with `dir="rtl"`, greps the rendered HTML for `left:|right:|margin-left|margin-right`; asserts none.
8. **Unit — RowActions persistence (`frontend/__tests__/components/domain/RowActions.test.tsx`)** — asserts the overflow trigger is in the DOM with no hover event and `getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== "hidden"` (UX-02).
9. **Unit — ForbiddenState leak guard (`frontend/__tests__/components/domain/ForbiddenState.test.tsx`)** — renders every documented variant, greps innerHTML for `/[0-9\u0660-\u0669]/`, asserts no match (UX-06). Asserts the rendered icon, headline copy and accent are all different from `EmptyState`'s.
10. **Unit — EmptyState vs ForbiddenState distinction (`frontend/__tests__/components/domain/EmptyStateVsForbidden.test.tsx`)** — snapshots both and asserts the a11y name, icon slot value and heading colour token are all different.
11. **Unit — Shell direction (`frontend/__tests__/app/layout.test.tsx`)** — renders `RootLayout` in Arabic mode; asserts `<html dir="rtl" lang="ar">`; renders in English mode; asserts `<html dir="ltr" lang="en">`.
12. **Lint — physical-utility ban (`frontend/__tests__/lint/no-physical-utilities.test.ts`)** — invokes the ESLint API against a fixture string containing `<div className="ml-4 text-left">` and asserts an error is raised.
13. **Lint — primitive/literal ban (`frontend/__tests__/lint/no-primitives.test.ts`)** — invokes ESLint against `<div className="bg-n-800">` and `<div style={{ color: "#123456" }}>`; asserts both raise errors.
14. **Lint — layer separation (`frontend/__tests__/lint/no-ui-from-screens.test.ts`)** — invokes ESLint against a fake screen that imports from `@/components/ui/button`; asserts the `no-restricted-imports` rule fires.
15. **Script — `check-tokens.mjs`** — Vitest integration test that spawns the script against a fixture folder containing an illegal primitive and asserts a non-zero exit code.

## Migration / Rollback

- Rollback is a single-commit revert: no database migrations, no backend changes, no data touched. If the Tailwind 4 install destabilises the frontend, `git revert` this story's merge commit and `pnpm install` restores the prior lock.
- **Partial-apply risk:** if the token layer lands but the ESLint rules do not, code will start referencing primitives and hex literals immediately. Land the ESLint rules in the **same** commit as the token layer, or gate the merge behind CI.
- **Font licence:** ship `SIL OFL 1.1` verbatim in `frontend/public/fonts/ibm-plex/LICENSE.txt`. Do not delete it in follow-up cleanups.

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend installs:** `cd frontend && pnpm install`.
2. **Frontend builds:** `cd frontend && pnpm build`. Must complete with no warnings about external font loaders.
3. **Frontend runs:** `cd frontend && pnpm dev`, open `http://localhost:3000`, confirm the sample page renders with Plex Sans, `<html dir="ltr" lang="en">`, and no console errors.
4. **Frontend lints:** `cd frontend && pnpm lint`. Must exit 0. Then introduce `<div className="ml-2">` in `app/page.tsx` and re-run — must exit non-zero.
5. **Frontend tests:** `cd frontend && pnpm vitest run`. All tests in the plan above must pass.
6. **Token script:** `cd frontend && pnpm run lint:tokens`. Must exit 0.
7. **RTL smoke:** temporarily flip `RootLayout` to `dir="rtl"` and reload `/`; the sample page must mirror without any visual regression that would indicate a leaked physical utility.
8. **Regression — backend:** `cd backend && ./vendor/bin/phpunit`. All existing tests still green (this story does not touch backend).
